fire_when: An agent is about to mark C0047 formally proved from a scope note while the named comparator theorem body still contains sorry.
silent_when: An agent is merely reading a preprint as an unverified claim or recording the conjecture's source statement.
text: Before a formal-proof verdict, inspect the exact theorem body, assumptions and trusted axioms. A scope note or declaration with sorry is not a proof receipt; keep the status unverified.
